messages:
Priya Shah: quick capture from today's ACME check-in — pulling verbatim asks into one thread so product can triage

Priya Shah: ACME listed 5 priority items (short bullets):
- need an onboarding playbook template in Console (they want a checkbox flow + progress state they can share internally)
- ask: tag API requests with customer-defined labels (e.g., product_line=search) so finance can map costs per team
- intermittent 500s on text-embedding endpoint when payloads contain long html blobs (seen twice during sample import)
- request for SLA language around 95th pct tail latency for embeddings (sales/legal ask)
- UX: route-level filters on the usage dashboard (filter by model, route, label) and CSV export

Aaron (ACME): confirming — onboarding checklist would unblock internal ops. currently they copy/paste notes across teams.

Marisol (CS): flagged renewal caution — they said they won't finalize until tagging + billing mapping is available. risk = high if we don't show progress. :warning:

Ethan Liu: can we get one raw failing request (headers + body) from their import? 500s sound like input-parsing or tokenizer edge case.

Priya Shah: attached sanitized example in shared drive (link): https://redwood.prod/notes/acme-import-sample. it includes full payload + response body.

Jonah - Product: my initial triage / prioritization suggestion (quick, medium, deep):
1) Playbook UX: small effort, docs + Console checklist prototype (owner: devex + docs, target 2 weeks)
2) Request tagging: requires API schema + backend billing mapping (owner: product + billing eng, scope 3 sprints) — high business impact
3) 500s root-cause: incident-level priority (owner: eng-runtime/eng-ml, immediate spike)
4) SLA scoping: legal + sales to define required numbers; product to evaluate feasibility with infra (medium effort)
5) Dashboard filters + CSV: product-UX scoped as nice-to-have but requested by finance (low-medium)

FeedbackBot: created Productboard items: PB-812 "Customer labels for per-route billing" and PB-813 "Onboarding checklist in Console". Linked to CS ticket CS-FEED-298

Marisol (CS): Can we fast-track the 500 repro? ACME is pausing procurement until that is investigated.

Ethan Liu: starting repro on staging now. will run payloads from the sample and check tokenizer/overflow/timeout. tagging @infra-oncall if we hit infra limits. ETA for initial findings: 48 hours.

infra-oncall: acknowledged — we'll keep an eye on staging cluster metrics and open a short-lived trace if needed.

Priya Shah: I'll update ACME with plan + timelines. Also asked them to prioritize which of the billing labels they want first (model vs route vs product_line). Aaron will confirm.

Aaron (ACME): will confirm label priority by EOD tomorrow. thanks for moving quickly. :thumbsup:

Jonah - Product: I'll own the roadmap mapping. Priya/Marisol, please add acceptance criteria to the Notion CS handoff doc; I'll convert PB items to epics after the spike.

Priya Shah: noted. posting the follow-up checklist in the CS shared note and will ping when Aaron confirms labels.
_meta: This thread is a single Slack conversation captured as one continuous string. Messages are chronological and prefixed by display name. No title field per agents.md rules.
